item.title: Ask HN: Anything as Fast as Google's AI Mode in the CLI?
item.summary: I'm realising that Google's AI mode is the fastest for quick questions. Like questions about how to do X in library Y. Is it possible to use it from the CLI? Alternatively, what is a good fast free model that folks use for this purpose? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49232797 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
